{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (they are not conversions)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rates}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.4f}")"}
